（印：O. I. B. HEADQUARTERS FILE No. L/181 DATE 9.3.31）
File No. L 91
February 27, 1931.

(C.I.D.) Office Notes
D. C. (C. & S. B.)

Sir,
I have made careful enquiries into the allegations contained in the attached letter but have been unable to obtain any evidence to support the suggestion of malpractice by detectives.

The facts of the case are contained in attached case papers, L 91. C.D.C. 184 was on Station duty when the complaint was first made at Louza Station, and consequently he was sent, with C.D.C. 243, to witness what took place in the teashop when the complainant met the alleged extortioners. There is no evidence to show that the C.D.C. knew the complainant and he (the C.D.C.) states that he met him for the first time when the complaint was made at Louza Station.

The statement that the accused in the first instance later became the complainant is incorrect. The C.D.C. did not ask for a reward and no person connected with the case was detained in the station cells at the time the anonymous letter was written.

The complaint was laid on January 9, the arrests effected on January 10 (Saturday) and the case heard on January 12. All accused were found not guilty and released on same day.

I examined C.P.C.692 but could obtain no information from him regarding the acceptance of a bribe by the C.D.C. The seal used on the envelope is not the one in use at Louza Station.

I have delayed forwarding this report as I heard that a counter-action against the complainant, for laying a false complaint, was contemplated by the five accused persons. Private criminal proceedings were actually instituted and the case heard on February 24. In this instance also a verdict of not guilty was passed.

（签名）

（印：O. I. B. 总部档案号 L/181 日期 31年3月9日）
档案号 L 91
1931年2月27日。

（刑事调查处）办公笔记
副总监（罪案与特别分部）

先生，
我已对附信中所含的指控进行了仔细查问，但未能获得任何证据来支持警探行为不端的说法。

本案事实载于附件案件卷宗 L 91 中。当投诉最初在老闸捕房提出时，华籍巡长（C.D.C.）184号正在该捕房值班，因此他被派往，并与华籍巡长（C.D.C.）243号一同，去见证投诉人与被指称的勒索者会面时在茶馆内发生的情况。没有证据显示该华籍巡长认识投诉人，且他（该华籍巡长）称，当投诉在老闸捕房提出时，他是第一次见到投诉人。

所谓起初的被告后来变成了投诉人的说法是不正确的。该华籍巡长并未索取酬金，且在匿名信撰写之时，没有任何与本案有关的人员被拘押在捕房拘留所内。

投诉于1月9日提出，逮捕于1月10日（星期六）执行，案件于1月12日审理。所有被告均被判无罪并于同日释放。

我讯问了华籍警员（C.P.C.）692号，但未能从他那里获得关于该华籍巡长收受贿赂的任何信息。信封上使用的印章并非老闸捕房当时使用的印章。

我推迟呈报此报告，是因为我听说五名被告正考虑对投诉人提起反诉，指控其提出虚假投诉。私人刑事诉讼程序确实已启动，案件于2月24日审理。在此案中，同样作出了无罪判决。

（签名）

Translation of the attached anonymous letter.

January 25, 1931.

R.C. Alers Esquire,
18 Hankow Road.

Sir,

I have to draw your attention to a case of mal-
practice on the part of C.D.I. Yu Ah Kung, C.D.C. 184
Yih Yueh S and C.D.C. 243 Chen Yung Kwei.

About two weeks ago a case of extortion was
reported to the Louza Police Station and was investi-
gated into by C.D.C. 184. The latter received $200
from the accused in the case with the result that, when
the case came up for hearing in the Court next morning,
the position of the complainant and the accused was
reversed: the complainant became the accused, and the
accused took the position of the complainant. The
C.D.C. asked the Court to remand the case for one week,
and the real complainant is now in the prisoners' cell.
All the arrangements were made through C.D.C. 243 Chen
Yung Kwei.

The real complainant has lodged an appeal through
his counsel Yih Feu Kong. The C.D.C.s fearing consequences
have asked C.D.I. Yu Ah Kung to mediate with a view to
bringing about an amicable settlement of the case. Four
or five conferences have been held in the Tsing Lien Ko
Teashop at Foochow Road. If you are doubtful of this
report, you can ask C.P.C.692 who knows all about this
case. Unless you cause confidential enquiries to be made,
the reputation of the Council will be greatly jeopardised.

It is to be noted that C.D.I. Yu Ah Kung is the 'Lao
Der Ts' of the two C.D.C.s, so he tries in every way to effect
an amicable settlement of the case.

(Unsigned).
page_data.zh:
附件匿名信的译文。

1931年1月25日。

R.C. Alers 先生，
汉口路18号。

先生，

我提请您注意一起涉及华籍探目（C.D.I.）余阿公（Yu Ah Kung）、华籍巡长（C.D.C.）184号 Yih Yueh S（音译）以及华籍巡长（C.D.C.）243号陈永贵（Chen Yung Kwei）的行为不端案件。

约两周前，一起勒索案向老闸捕房报案，并由华籍巡长（C.D.C.）184号进行调查。后者从该案被告处收取了200元，结果是，当案件次日早晨在法庭开庭审理时，投诉人和被告的地位发生了逆转：投诉人变成了被告，而被告则占据了投诉人的位置。该华籍巡长请求法庭将案件延期一周审理，而真正的投诉人现在被关在囚室中。所有安排均通过华籍巡长（C.D.C.）243号陈永贵进行。

真正的投诉人已通过其律师 Yih Feu Kong（音译）提出上诉。华籍巡长们因害怕后果，已请求华籍探目（C.D.I.）余阿公进行调解，以期达成案件的和解。在福州路的青莲阁茶馆已举行了四五次会谈。如果您对此报告存疑，您可以询问华籍警员（C.P.C.）692号，他了解此案的所有情况。除非您进行机密查问，否则工部局的声誉将受到极大损害。

需要注意的是，华籍探目（C.D.I.）余阿公是这两名华籍巡长的“老大哥”（Lao Der Ts'），因此他千方百计试图促成案件的和解。

（未署名）。
